description: Live E2E for the Particles RQL module. Driven by tests/e2e/run_tool_e2e.py (scripts/extension_live.py) against ONE connected headless editor and a local gamedev-mcp-server. The module ships no MCP tools: every call is the core rql-query / rql-mutate / rql-schema, and a regression in the module (adapters, validation, guide) turns the suite red.
notes: The 'setup' opens a fresh scene (root Node3D 'Root') with the core editor | call NewScene. rql-schema proves the module was discovered (its adapter description). The 'tools' then run every ParticlesGuide example in order (the xUnit suite asserts this list contains them all, in order, each with rql-mutate for set / call and rql-query otherwise), followed by read-back queries. 'expect' substrings are matched against the default compact RQL text inside godot-cli's --raw JSON: rows are '|'-separated, so 'FX|32' is the name and Amount columns of one row.

input.query: nodes | where name == "FX" | set Amount = 32, Lifetime = 2, Explosiveness = 0.5, Randomness = 0.25, OneShot = false
nodes | where name == "FX" | set Emitting = false
nodes | where $ is GPUParticles3D | select name Amount Lifetime Emitting Explosiveness ProcessMaterial
